items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When I was in Miles’ band, Dave Holland and I had a growing affinity for playing together... We actually rehearsed at our 19th Street loft... and that’s how that all began.

ctx.x: Then Jack DeJohnette comes in. But Dave Holland was there when you got there.
Dave was there when I got there, yeah.

The reason I’m asking... This maybe will seem like a bit of a stretch as a question. But you mentioned your involvement particularly in hearing Stockhausen’s music, and there were things that you were doing on Ring Modulator with Miles that had an affinity to some of Stockhausen’s musique concrete. I’m wondering if you can elaborate on some of the ideas that were elaborated while you were there, and maybe take us to what you were doing subsequently in Circle. I know you and Dave Holland were very close at that…
